title: Prevent status-only promotion of latent-ceiling predictions
finding: The committed prediction rows cite only the preregistration document. Before this packet, changing only a row's status from prediction to measured was structurally valid, so future corpus completion could accidentally treat an unchanged preregistered guess as measured evidence.
primary_claim: A row that cites only the exact preregistration prediction reference can no longer be parsed as measured. The same reference may be retained for provenance when at least one additional measured-evidence reference is added. This blocks status-only promotion without inventing a second evidence schema or claiming that arbitrary reference strings are independently verified.
gardener_decision: Add one narrow row invariant at the existing parser boundary. Do not add a rater registry, evidence store, provenance service, vector database, second corpus format, or alternate latent evaluator.
acceptance: the unchanged committed prediction-only corpus remains valid and incomplete
changing only status=prediction to status=measured while retaining only the preregistration reference is refused
a measured row may retain the preregistration reference when additional measured evidence is cited
existing complete-corpus, frozen-revision, denominator, identity and threshold behavior remains unchanged
no numeric ceiling, latent benefit, Tensor performance, benchmark superiority, OwnerApproval, promotion or gate transition is claimed by this packet
